target.title: fix(tui): suppress unhandled rejection from async agent event handler
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `onAgentEvent` callback in `EmbeddedTuiBackend` calls `void this.handleAgentEvent(evt)` without a `.catch()` handler. Since `handleAgentEvent` is async and can reject, this creates an unhandled promise rejection that crashes the TUI process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add a noop `.catch(() => {})` to suppress the unhandled rejection, matching the pattern used elsewhere in the codebase for fire-and-forget async callbacks.

## User Impact

Prevents the TUI from crashing when an agent event handler throws.

## Evidence

- **Source**: `src/tui/embedded-backend.ts:325`
- **Test**: `pnpm test src/tui/embedded-backend` passes
- The fix follows the same pattern as `src/gateway/server/ws-connection.ts` and other fire-and-forget async handlers.
